title: Programming & Software Construction
summary: From basic syntax to professional Java software construction, algorithms, testing, debugging and maintainable code.

modules.title: Programming mental models
modules.summary: Understand execution, state and decomposition before language/framework complexity.
modules.why: Weak execution models create bugs that frameworks cannot hide.

units.title: Values, types & control flow
units.summary: Reason about values, representations, expressions and control flow.
units.challenge: Build small deterministic console programs without copying templates.
units.evidence: A repo of ten tiny programs plus notes explaining state changes line-by-line.

units.title: Functions, methods & decomposition
units.summary: Break behaviour into explicit inputs, outputs and responsibilities.
units.challenge: Refactor a monolithic CLI into cohesive functions with explicit contracts.
units.evidence: Before/after design note showing improved cohesion and testability.

units.title: Debugging as a scientific process
units.summary: Form hypotheses, inspect state and isolate faults systematically.
units.challenge: Diagnose five seeded bugs without adding random print statements.
units.evidence: Bug journal: symptom, hypothesis, observation, root cause and prevention for each bug.

modules.title: Discrete reasoning & complexity
modules.summary: Learn the mathematical vocabulary needed for algorithms, data structures and scale reasoning.
modules.why: Architectural decisions rely on growth rates, probability and discrete structures even when no formal proof is written.

units.title: Sets, logic, relations & invariants
units.summary: Use set/logic language to state correctness precisely.
units.challenge: Write invariants for loops, collections and permission checks.
units.evidence: A short correctness note for three small algorithms.

units.title: Time, space & amortized complexity
units.summary: Predict how code behaves as input grows.
units.challenge: Benchmark multiple implementations and compare empirical vs asymptotic behaviour.
units.evidence: Complexity table plus benchmark chart and explanation of mismatches.

units.title: Probability intuition for engineers
units.summary: Understand randomness, collision risk and probabilistic data structures.
units.challenge: Estimate UUID collision risk and Bloom-filter false positives for realistic workloads.
units.evidence: Worked estimates with assumptions and validation script.

modules.title: Java language foundations
modules.summary: Build fluency with modern Java syntax and semantics, not just loops and streams.
modules.why: Framework expertise is fragile without language fluency.

units.title: Java types, numbers & strings
units.summary: Understand primitives, wrappers, references and common value semantics.
units.challenge: Implement money and text-processing exercises while avoiding precision and null bugs.
units.evidence: Tests demonstrating overflow, equality and precision edge cases.

units.title: Classes, records, enums & packages
units.summary: Model data and behaviour using the right Java construct.
units.challenge: Model the same domain using mutable classes and immutable records; compare trade-offs.
units.evidence: Domain model plus a short decision memo.

units.title: Modern Java language features
units.summary: Stay current with language features that simplify expressive, safe code.
units.challenge: Refactor a type-dispatch workflow using sealed hierarchies and pattern matching.
units.evidence: Before/after code with compatibility notes for the chosen JDK.

modules.title: Object-oriented modeling in Java
modules.summary: Use encapsulation and polymorphism to represent stable domain concepts without inheritance-heavy design.
modules.why: Good architecture begins with good boundaries inside a single process.

units.title: Encapsulation, invariants & value objects
units.summary: Protect valid state instead of exposing setters everywhere.
units.challenge: Create domain objects that cannot represent invalid state.
units.evidence: Tests proving invariants cannot be bypassed through the public API.

units.title: Interfaces, polymorphism & composition
units.summary: Decouple behaviour using explicit abstractions and composition.
units.challenge: Implement a pluggable notification subsystem without condition-heavy type branching.
units.evidence: Class diagram plus tests swapping implementations.

units.title: Inheritance, sealed hierarchies & trade-offs
units.summary: Know when inheritance models a true subtype and when it creates coupling.
units.challenge: Refactor an inheritance-heavy design and document the cases where inheritance remains justified.
units.evidence: Trade-off note with concrete before/after coupling examples.

modules.title: Collections & generics
modules.summary: Understand Java collection behaviour, internal trade-offs and type-safe reusable APIs.
modules.why: Collections appear in almost every service and their complexity/semantics leak into performance and correctness.

units.title: List, Set, Map, Queue & Deque contracts
units.summary: Choose collection types from required semantics rather than habit.
units.challenge: Select collection types for ten product scenarios and defend each choice.
units.evidence: Decision table with semantics and complexity.

units.title: Hash tables, trees, heaps & collection internals
units.summary: Connect collection APIs to underlying data structures.
units.challenge: Implement simplified hash map and heap structures, then benchmark against JDK collections.
units.evidence: Implementation + benchmark + explanation of collision/resizing behaviour.

units.title: Generics, variance & API design
units.summary: Use generics to express reusable constraints without unsafe casts.
units.challenge: Design a generic processing API and remove raw types/casts from an existing codebase.
units.evidence: Compiler-enforced examples showing which invalid calls are rejected.

modules.title: Lambdas, streams & functional style
modules.summary: Use functional transformations deliberately while understanding laziness, state and parallelism.
modules.why: Streams are powerful but can hide complexity and side effects when used mechanically.

units.title: Lambdas & functional interfaces
units.summary: Treat behaviour as values while keeping side effects explicit.
units.challenge: Replace callback classes with functional interfaces while preserving readability.
units.evidence: Refactoring with tests and a note on captured state.

units.title: Stream pipelines & collectors
units.summary: Build correct lazy pipelines and custom aggregations.
units.challenge: Build a non-trivial reporting pipeline with nested grouping and error handling.
units.evidence: Pipeline tests plus equivalent imperative version and readability comparison.

units.title: Parallel streams: when not to use them
units.summary: Understand fork/join execution, data partitioning and side-effect hazards.
units.challenge: Benchmark sequential vs parallel pipelines across CPU and I/O workloads.
units.evidence: Benchmark report explaining when parallelism regresses performance.

modules.title: Exceptions, resources & I/O
modules.summary: Design failure semantics and handle files/streams/resources safely.
modules.why: Production failures become operational incidents when error contracts and resource ownership are unclear.

units.title: Exception design & error contracts
units.summary: Use exceptions to model exceptional failure without swallowing context.
units.challenge: Create a layered error model for validation, persistence and external dependency failures.
units.evidence: Error taxonomy plus API tests for error translation.

units.title: Resource ownership & try-with-resources
units.summary: Prevent leaked files, sockets and database handles.
units.challenge: Reproduce and then eliminate file/socket descriptor leaks.
units.evidence: OS-level before/after evidence showing leaked resources disappear.

units.title: Java I/O, NIO & serialization boundaries
units.summary: Choose buffered, channel and async I/O patterns consciously.
units.challenge: Implement a file-copy/service-ingestion task using multiple I/O styles and compare performance.
units.evidence: Measured throughput and memory profile with recommendation.

modules.title: Core data structures & algorithms
modules.summary: Build practical algorithm fluency and connect structures to systems components.
modules.why: Indexes, caches, schedulers, routing and search all reuse these foundations.

units.title: Arrays, strings, linked structures, stacks & queues
units.summary: Master linear structures and common traversal patterns.
units.challenge: Solve representative problems and implement a bounded queue from scratch.
units.evidence: Complexity-annotated solutions plus queue tests.

units.title: Trees, heaps & tries
units.summary: Use hierarchical and priority structures for ordered/ranked access.
units.challenge: Implement autocomplete trie and priority scheduler.
units.evidence: Working implementations with complexity notes.

units.title: Graphs & graph traversal
units.summary: Model networks, dependencies and reachability.
units.challenge: Build dependency analysis and shortest-path tools.
units.evidence: Graph library plus examples mapped to service/dependency problems.

modules.title: Algorithmic techniques
modules.summary: Learn reusable problem-solving patterns beyond memorized interview questions.
modules.why: Senior engineers need to recognize computational shape quickly and avoid accidental quadratic systems.

units.title: Searching, sorting & selection
units.summary: Understand ordered access, partitioning and sorting trade-offs.
units.challenge: Implement and benchmark sorting/searching variants across data sizes.
units.evidence: Benchmark plus explanation of algorithm choice.

units.title: Greedy, dynamic programming & backtracking
units.summary: Recognize overlapping subproblems, local-choice structure and search spaces.
units.challenge: Solve one representative problem with each technique and explain why alternatives fail.
units.evidence: Three solution notes emphasizing reasoning rather than final code.

units.title: Probabilistic data structures
units.summary: Trade exactness for memory/throughput using controlled error.
units.challenge: Add a Bloom filter in front of a simulated expensive lookup and measure savings/error.
units.evidence: Measured false-positive rate vs theoretical expectation.

modules.title: Git, builds, dependencies & developer tooling
modules.summary: Operate the software lifecycle confidently from local changes through reproducible builds.
modules.why: Engineering speed and safety depend on version control, dependency hygiene and debugging fluency.

units.title: Git model & collaboration workflows
units.summary: Understand commits/refs/merges well enough to recover from mistakes.
units.challenge: Recover a deliberately tangled repository without deleting history.
units.evidence: Command log and explanation of final history.

units.title: Build systems & dependency management
units.summary: Make builds reproducible and dependency graphs intentional.
units.challenge: Create a multi-module Java build and diagnose a dependency conflict.
units.evidence: Dependency graph before/after conflict resolution.

units.title: Static analysis, IDE debugging & code review
units.summary: Use tools to prevent and diagnose defects before production.
units.challenge: Add quality gates to a small repo and review a deliberately poor pull request.
units.evidence: Tool configuration plus review comments grouped by correctness/design/maintainability.

modules.title: Testing fundamentals
modules.summary: Build fast feedback into software construction before learning broader production test strategy.
modules.why: Testing should be learned with programming, not postponed until deployment.

units.title: Unit tests & testable design
units.summary: Test behaviour through stable public contracts.
units.challenge: Write tests first for a small domain service and refactor implementation safely.
units.evidence: Test suite demonstrating behaviour, boundaries and edge cases.

units.title: Mocks, stubs, fakes & test doubles
units.summary: Isolate collaboration without over-mocking implementation details.
units.challenge: Rewrite a brittle mock-heavy suite using a mix of fakes and integration tests.
units.evidence: Flakiness/coupling comparison before and after.

units.title: Integration tests with real dependencies
units.summary: Validate database/network boundaries using disposable real infrastructure.
units.challenge: Run repository/API tests against a real PostgreSQL container.
units.evidence: Repeatable local/CI integration test setup.

modules.title: Refactoring, design principles & patterns
modules.summary: Make change cheap through cohesion, coupling control, clear boundaries and selective patterns.
modules.why: The first architecture a developer owns is the structure of the codebase itself.

units.title: Cohesion, coupling & information hiding
units.summary: Evaluate design by how changes propagate.
units.challenge: Map change propagation in a tangled service and refactor boundaries.
units.evidence: Dependency diagram before/after plus change-impact comparison.

units.title: SOLID as design heuristics & refactoring
units.summary: Use principles as problem-solving heuristics rather than rules to worship.
units.challenge: Refactor a feature with tests while documenting which principle actually improved changeability.
units.evidence: Refactoring sequence and decision log.

units.title: Design patterns in context
units.summary: Recognize recurring forces and choose patterns only when they reduce complexity.
units.challenge: Implement three patterns around real requirements and remove one unnecessary pattern.
units.evidence: Pattern decision record including rejected alternatives and cost.
